decisions.reason: The Trivital supplement range builds on the firm's established pharmacy channel and costs little to maintain, so keeping the line keeps the option open while its value is still being learned.
The skin and hair supplement shares brand, channel and manufacturing with the range, so holding it costs little despite crowded competition and no clear evidence yet that it has failed.
Joint health is a steady pharmacy supplement category, and with low carrying costs and no negative signal the option is worth keeping open.
The immune supplement launched just before the pandemic-driven rise in immune product demand, which favours keeping it and possibly investing further.

The 2018 valsartan impurity recall hit the whole industry, but a generic blood pressure drug serves a large, stable market; once supply is re-sourced, the low marginal cost of keeping it outweighs dropping it, though the risk is elevated.
The OTC migraine triptan is a differentiated pharmacy product in a niche with few competitors, and it is still early in resolving its uncertainty, so it is worth holding.
